newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kansas City Southern cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kansas City Southern cut.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim cut its rating for Kansas City Southern Industries to perform in line from outperform.

-- Analysts James Hanbury, Gary Yablon and Rob Davis wrote that the downgraded stemmed from the $1.4 billion bid from Kansas City Southern and Tranportacion Maritima Mexicana for a section -- Line 1 -- of the Mexican state railroad.
-- Projections "entail massive revenue growth ... and improvement in the operating ratio from current levels in the range of 90 percent to 50 percent," they wrote.

-- "Despite what we view as a high price tag, if Line 1 were to come near these projections, by Year 3 this acquisition would offer substantial returns, and in our mind would be a clear win" for the company's stock.

-- For such improvements to be reached, "we believe that substantial improvement in operations would be required, and we think that this improvement will be a real challenge to achieve, particularly in the time frame" the company has outlined, they wrote.
-- Kansas City Southern's shares were up 5/8 to 45-1/4.
